description: Stop an agent at once: nothing runs, nothing waiting is kept, and its open orders on Lighter are cancelled. Positions and their stops stay as they are, unless closePositions is true (every position closed at market, which needs a key that may act). Works with any access key: stopping is always allowed. resume_agent brings it back.

closePositions.description: Also close every position at market on Lighter.

name: stop_agent
title: Stop an agent now
